notes.summary: Conditional same-start affine comparison recovers closed Legendre levels and genuine relative P ceilings; finite-start infinite-slope targets also have joint entropy divergence. No geometric density or raw mixed-mass continuity is proved.
notes.detailedSummary: On a fixed connected smooth compact Kähler manifold, actual E1 rays with identical w and u_t-C_j <= v_j,t <= u_t+epsilon_j*t+C_j for all points and times, with epsilon_j>=0 tending to zero, satisfy the same bounds without C_j. They recover bounded-time d1, analytic energy slopes, actual usual data on the full supported-semivaluation carrier, and NA energies. Every closed Legendre level converges pointwise; genuine psh relative ceilings also converge in L1, and a minus-infinite target level has uniform upper divergence. With finite initial entropy and infinite target entropy slope, every joint index/time entropy ratio diverges. This is an additional sufficient analytic hypothesis, not a geometric construction. No raw-mass, singularity-metric or fixed-time entropy continuity is inferred. Energy defects converge, so late approximants satisfying this criterion for a nonmaximal target must themselves be nonmaximal.
notes.text:
This is a conditional analytic theorem, not a solution of original P19.2.

Work on a connected smooth compact Kähler X of dimension n>=1. Fix omega, V=int_X omega^n, mu0=omega^n/V, dd^c=(i/2pi)partial barpartial and t=-log|tau|^2. Use E(h)=1/((n+1)V) sum_{k=0}^n int_X h <omega_h^k> wedge omega^(n-k), extended to E1; E(0)=0 and E(h+c)=E(h)+c. MA is the nonpluripolar top product divided by V. H is full probability entropy relative to mu0, infinite without absolute continuity. Actual weak rays are strongly continuous at zero and canonical finite-energy geodesics on every finite interval.

Exact premises used without independent reproof: complete caller body R supplies finite-interval Perron comparison, affine time addition, ordered d1 equal to energy difference, affine ray energy, finite-energy mixed cohomological masses, usual NA divisorial order determination, finite signed contracted-energy recession for arbitrary rays, and infinite entropy recession for nonmaximal rays. Complete S supplies P_w[chi]=chi at genuine psh Legendre levels, where P_w[h]=usc lim_C P_omega(h+C,w). Complete E supplies contracted-energy d1 continuity and lower semicontinuity/geodesic convexity of M=H+G with entropy coefficient one. These mathematical bodies in their stated scopes, rather than historical verdicts or hashes, are the premises. No new external theorem is essential.

For actual rays v,u from the identical prescribed w, suppose v_t<=u_t+a*t+C at every point and time, with finite C. For T>t compare v on [0,T] with the canonical segment u_s+a*s+C*s/T from w to u_T+a*T+C. Perron comparison gives v_t<=u_t+a*t+C*t/T. Sending T to infinity removes C. Applying this twice shows that u_t-C_j<=v_j,t<=u_t+epsilon_j*t+C_j implies u_t<=v_j,t<=u_t+epsilon_j*t. Ordered energy and translation give d1(v_j,t,u_t)<=epsilon_j*t and 0<=c_vj-c_u<=epsilon_j for their affine energy slopes. The start w is retained exactly; it may be unbounded, nonmodel and initially of infinite entropy for this level theorem.

Define chi_u(lambda)=inf_{t>=0}(u_t-lambda*t). Taking infima of the established bounds over the entire half-line gives chi_u(lambda)<=chi_vj(lambda)<=chi_u(lambda-epsilon_j). For each x, the transform is decreasing and upper semicontinuous as an infimum of continuous affine functions of lambda, or identically minus infinite. It has no positive infinite values. Consequently chi_u(lambda-delta)(x) decreases to chi_u(lambda)(x) as delta decreases to zero. Squeezing proves convergence at every original closed parameter, including endpoints, without exchanging an index limit with an unbounded-time infimum.

At genuine psh target and approximating levels, S identifies the transforms with their actual relative ceilings against the same w. They lie between the integrable genuine target and the finite constant sup_X w, so dominated convergence gives L1 convergence. This statement explicitly assumes the pertinent levels are genuine psh; no unbounded minimum-principle theorem is silently imported. If the target level is identically minus infinite, set delta_j=sup_{m>=j}epsilon_m decreasing to zero. The usc upper bounds chi_u(lambda-delta_j) decrease to minus infinity on compact X. Their open sublevel sets below -A form an increasing cover for each A>0. Compactness gives an index covering all X, proving sup_X chi_vj(lambda)->-infinity. No current, probability measure or singularity metric is assigned to this placeholder.

For the actual usual NA data phi,psi_j, the ray bounds give phi<=psi_j<=phi+epsilon_j on generic Gauss divisors: t has coefficient -b_F log|s_F|^2, and usual data are negative generic coefficients divided by the actual time multiplicity b_F. R's divisorial order determination extends the inequalities to the original full X^beth, including supported semivaluations. No pole is pointwise divided by time. NA energy monotonicity and translation give errors at most epsilon_j. Thus defects delta=E_alpha(phi)-c_u and delta_j=E_alpha(psi_j)-c_vj differ by at most epsilon_j. If delta>0, sufficiently late approximants satisfying this criterion must themselves be nonmaximal. This does not classify all permissible geometric or flag approximations.

For joint entropy divergence, additionally assume H(w)<infinity and H(u_t)/t->infinity. Define T_gamma(h)=V^-1 sum_{k=0}^{n-1} int_X h gamma wedge <omega_h^k> wedge omega^(n-1-k), Ric=-dd^c log omega^n, Sbar=n/V int_X Ric wedge omega^(n-1), and G=T_-Ric+Sbar*E. For smooth positive closed gamma, ordered h<=k<=h+c imply 0<=T_gamma(k)-T_gamma(h)<=K_gamma*c, where K_gamma=n/V int_X gamma wedge omega^(n-1). In the bounded domain differentiate along the affine psh segment: the derivative is n/V int_X(k-h)gamma wedge omega_segment^(n-1), which is nonnegative. Translation adds K_gamma*c. Ordered bounded truncations and E's contracted-energy continuity pass this to E1, using R's fixed mixed masses. A fixed positive decomposition of -Ric gives |G(v_j,t)-G(u_t)|<=K*epsilon_j*t. R supplies finite g_u=lim G(u_t)/t; every joint correction therefore converges to g_u.

Put f_j(t)=M(v_j,t), f(t)=M(u_t), and a=M(w)<infinity. Extended convexity gives f_j(t)/t>=a/t+(f_j(T)-a)/T for t>=T>0. If f_j(T) is infinite, convexity with finite initial value forces all later values infinite, so the inequality remains valid. Fixed-time d1 convergence and lower semicontinuity give liminf_j f_j(T)>=f(T). Every joint liminf is therefore at least (f(T)-a)/T. Infinite target entropy recession and finite g_u imply f(t)/t->infinity. One infinite finite-time value, or letting T grow after taking the joint liminf, proves joint divergence of f_j(t_j)/t_j. Subtracting the finite G correction gives every joint H(v_j,t_j)/t_j->infinity. This includes nonmaximal targets by R, conditional on existence of the comparison sequence.

No geometric construction satisfying this stronger comparison for arbitrary data, raw mixed-mass continuity, singularity-metric convergence or fixed-time entropy continuity is supplied. Infinite-initial-entropy recovery lies outside this chord argument. A uniformly bounded pointwise difference between two rays from the same start would force equality by the first comparison lemma; that stronger invented topology cannot replace the original task.

The complete partial proof is in P19.2-paper.tex, Sections 4–5; its source is P19.2-argument.md and compiled reader is build/P19.2-paper.pdf. Rerun python build_paper.py. All new arguments remain unverified research drafts; compilation does not certify mathematics.

notes.summary: On CPn, n>=2, distinct genuine closed relative P profiles have identical complete scalar raw mixed-mass profiles, energy and entropy, including distinct zero-mass endpoints. This is information loss, not approximation nonexistence.
notes.detailedSummary: The actual hyperplane blowup rays for H_0={Z_0=0} and H_1={Z_1=0} both start at zero, have energy -nt/(n+1), identical finite-time entropy and raw mixed masses min(1,-lambda)^k for every lambda<=0 and k=1,...,n. Their terminal relative P ceilings are distinct genuine potentials log(|Z_i|^2/sum|Z_r|^2), each with every positive-degree raw mass zero. Their usual full-carrier data -min(v(H_i),1) are different and retained. Rational relatively ample T-sE_i models recover each respective datum, with E providing joint entropy recovery. A separate actual product-ray diagnostic shows that moving terminal parameters can destroy fixed-parameter endpoint continuity despite energy and entropy recovery. Neither diagnostic rules out existence for the full task.
notes.text:
This is an analytic information-loss example, not a counterexample to existence in the full original P19.2 signature.

Use X=CPn, n>=2, omega_FS with volume one, dd^c=(i/2pi)partial barpartial, squared-log time and full probability entropy relative to omega_FS^n. Put H_i={Z_i=0}, i=0,1, N=sum_r|Z_r|^2 and a_i,t=log((|Z_i|^2+e^-t sum_{r!=i}|Z_r|^2)/N).

Exact caller grants used without reproof: complete C supplies the actual nef semiample hyperplane blowup, its smooth zero-start maximal ray, intersections, entropy calibration and polarized radial mixed-distribution formula. The unitary permutation Z_0<->Z_1 preserves FS and transports this construction without changing its domain. Complete S supplies genuine-level relative Perron recognition and actual rational relative ampleness of T-sE in this same geometric signature. Complete E supplies joint entropy recovery for maximal rays from the identical finite-entropy start when actual model data converge strongly with entropy recovery. Historical verdicts are not premises.

The blowup center is H_i x {0}; T-E_i is generated over the affine time chart by divided sections Z_i,tau Z_r for r!=i. Strict and exceptional central components have time multiplicity one, with exceptional relative canonical coefficient one and discrepancy (1+1-1)/1=1. The usual datum is phi_i(v)=-min(v(H_i),1) on the full original carrier. Supports inside H_i have v(H_i)=infinity and value -1. A generic support in H_0 minus H_1 gives values -1 and 0 for the two data, so they are not identified. Their model probability measures are delta_ordHi, E_NA=-n/(n+1), and H_NA=1.

In the chart Z_i!=0 put rho=log sum_{r!=i}|Z_r/Z_i|^2, Q0=log(1+e^rho), and F(x)=x log x+(1-x)log(1-x), with continuous endpoint values. For 0<=q<=1, chi_i(-q)=W_i,q=sup_{0<=x<=q}(x*rho-F(x))-Q0. At 0<q<1 this follows by minimizing Q0(rho-t)+q*t: its increasing derivative q-Q0'(rho-t) gives either a minimum at time zero or at moment q. Thus W_i,q is zero below rho=log(q/(1-q)) and q*rho-F(q)-Q0 above that threshold. At q=0 the direct time limit is h_i=log(|Z_i|^2/N); at q>=1 the level is zero. At lambda>0 it is identically minus infinite.

The constrained radial weight is convex increasing, matches first derivatives at the interface and has asymptotic slope q. Its coefficient on H_i is 1-q, giving a genuine global psh potential, including q=0. By S it equals its actual P ceiling against the same start zero. C's polarized radial calculation gives nonpolar mixed distribution d(Q_q'^k Q0'^(n-k)), with normalized angular measure. Its endpoints are zero and q^k; matching slopes give no interface atom, and the ordinary divisor on H_i is excluded. Consequently M_k(chi_i(lambda))=min(1,-lambda)^k for every lambda<=0 and k=1,...,n. At zero all these masses vanish. The genuine currents there are [H_i], with zero nonpolar positive-degree products. Nevertheless h_0 and h_1 are different P ceilings: one is minus infinite on H_0 minus H_1 where the other is finite, and conversely.

Both energies are -n*t/(n+1), and both entropies are t+(n+1) int_0^1 n*x^(n-1)log(x+e^-t*(1-x)) dx, with remainder in [-(n+1)/n,0]. Thus identical complete scalar raw-mass profiles and all same-time energy and entropy values do not determine the actual P profile.

Actual rational ample data eta_i,s=-s*min(v(H_i),1), 0<s=A/M<1, come from M(T-sE_i), the restriction of O(M-A,A) under S's graph embedding. With a=1-s the component masses are a^n and 1-a^n, E_NA=(1-a^(n+1))/(n+1)-s and H_NA=1-a^n. As s increases to one, these data converge uniformly and strongly with entropy recovery to their respective, distinct phi_i. E gives every joint entropy ratio for the corresponding maximal rays from zero. The limit T-E_i is nef semiample and is not called relatively ample. No failure of existence is asserted.

The additional product diagnostic u_t=0, v_j,t=-t/j has the identical start zero and actual vertical divisor -j^-1 times the central fiber, relatively Kähler and rational relatively ample in a polarization. Its entropy is zero, energy is -t/j and recession d1 distance is 1/j. Nevertheless chi_vj(0) is a minus-infinite placeholder, whereas chi_u(0)=0 has all raw masses one. Their terminal parameters are -1/j and zero. This only disproves a fixed-parameter continuity implication without alignment. It fails n1's ordered orientation, and the trivial target has the product approximation.

Proof and geometry are in P19.2-paper.tex, Sections 6–7, with source P19.2-argument.md. Running python check_results.py verifies 3,036 rational model-intersection cases: n=2,...,12, denominator=2,...,24, and every positive numerator below the denominator. It also verifies 72,611 finite rational mass-bound cases. Thirty-five floating-point Legendre checks had maximum discrepancy 8.881784197001252e-16; twelve Simpson entropy observations lay inside the derived intervals. checks-output.json separates exhaustive finite arithmetic from numerical observations. Neither certifies the analytic argument.

notes.text:
The entire unchanged original P19.2 is not solved. n1 is an additional sufficient analytic comparison criterion; n2 demonstrates information loss. Neither constructs all required models or flags nor proves failure of existence in the actual full signature. candidate=false.

The exact complete caller grants are retained mathematically: R is the stated whole original fixed smooth compact-Kähler P19.1 body; T the zero-start finite-height one-branch P1 body; C the CPn n>=2 finite-entropy absolute-endpoint body; S its actual ample hyperplane geometry retaining one unbounded radial start, closed relative profile, raw masses, joint entropy and genuine-level relative lemma; E the general finite-entropy fixed-start maximal joint entropy body, including infinite-target-NA-entropy divergence. No grant expands another, and historical verdicts and hashes are not premises. Published projective special-Fujita and zero-start polarized log-discrepancy regimes remain subcases. P19.3 and P19.4 are not claimed.

Six concrete gaps remain: arbitrary prescribed-start/data/ray positive geometric or flag construction; arbitrary nonmaximal-ray recovery preserving its defect, or a universal obstruction; general closed finer relative P density and specified topology; all raw mixed-mass continuity, including genuine zero-mass versus minus-infinite boundaries; required fixed-time entropy recovery and infinite-initial-entropy recovery beyond the grants; and residual general log-discrepancy positivity and regularization without assumed relative semiampleness.
